worldcombat.skill.closecombat.summary: Drives into the foe's face without guarding and throws a burst of quick blows: point-blank physical combo, and the moment it commits the user's Defense and Sp. Def each drop one stage. The sweeping form clips others in a front arc at the cost of lower total power.
worldcombat.skill.closecombat.use.0: Throw a fast combo up close to finish a foe
worldcombat.skill.closecombat.use.1: Sweeping form to clip several foes bunched in front
worldcombat.skill.closecombat.use.2: Land the whole string before the target can step away
worldcombat.skill.closecombat.descriptio: Close in and throw up to %2$s blows for about %1$s physical damage; if the target is shoved out of reach the remaining blows whiff and the string ends early.
Strikes within %1$s blocks; blows are %2$s ticks apart, each blow steps you up to %4$s blocks toward the foe and shoves them %3$s blocks on a hit.
The guard is spent the moment it commits: the user's Defense drops %1$s stage(s) and Sp. Def drops %2$s, hit or miss.
worldcombat.skill.closecombat.wide.on: Sweeping form: every blow also clips other foes within a %1$s-degree arc in front for %2$s of that blow's power.
worldcombat.skill.closecombat.wide.off: Focused form: every blow lands on one target, with higher single-target power and a faster cast.
worldcombat.skill.closecombat.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.closecombat.growth.0: From level %1$s the combo power rises to %2$s and each string throws %3$s blows.
worldcombat.skill.closecombat.growth.1: From level %1$s the combo power rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.closecombat.preference: On: every blow also clips other foes in a front arc for a share of that blow's power; costs total power x0.85, recovery +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks. Off (focused): every blow lands on one target with higher single-target power and a faster cast.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens from farther, but it is easier to sidestep on the way in.
On: low-health targets rank higher so the fastest string finishes them before the price is paid; off: all targets score the same.
Below this own health ratio the user holds Close Combat back (0 = no limit). Higher saves the string for a worthwhile trade.
